title: THE VALUE OF GEN-AI CONVERSATIONS: A BOTTOM-UP FRAMEWORK FOR AI VALUE ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Collaborative Qualitative Analysis (CQA) of real-world user conversational logs to identify instances where the conversational agent subtly reinforced gender stereotypes in career recommendations or made presumptuous assumptions about a user's gender based on their stated interests (e.g., assuming a user interested in nursing is female).

Filtering conversational logs for ethically sensitive disclosures (such as health issues or disabilities) and applying qualitative analysis using a Value-Based Engineering ontology to identify insensitive, tactless, or dismissive AI responses (e.g., incorrectly directing users to disability organizations based on minor health limitations or ignoring intellectual skills).

Qualitative evaluation of chat logs to identify instances of 'misattribution' and 'presumptuousness,' such as the AI inappropriately mapping a user's physical characteristic (e.g., being overweight) to a specific career suggestion (e.g., dietologist).
